mathematics: An actual edge has at least two equal-word rows, hence a legal full-word witness. The proved stableCover gives an exact pointwise stable edge cover.
Distinct stable words form an antichain; ordered full-word edge intervals and common-word prefix comparability prove their edge ranks disjoint.
Union of edge intervals costs at most the sum of corresponding row counts, with disjoint full-word row fibers. Actual expected count, total marginals, and squared density follow with constant one.
public_type_and_model: All statements use the actual fixed-column sample and literal absolute integer ranks. Stable fallback is retained in the deterministic cover and removed by U05 retainedClass_stops from the empirical margin.
The interval bound places both m and m+1 inside the actual prefix interval. The arbitrary deterministic W discard bound does not assume independence or random-word deletion.
adversarial: Empty word sets, zero/singleton counts and empty anchors are covered.
The legality conversion requires n>0 explicitly; deterministic row/card bounds do not.
No edge crossing a stable cylinder boundary is silently counted inside it.
remaining: Final whole-graph first-moment finite aggregation remains U05-owned.
